HEALTHCARE PLUS SAMPLE HEALTH INSURANCE POLICY Policy ID: HP-2026-001 Policy Type: Comprehensive Health Insurance Coverage Period: 01 January 2026 - 31 December 2026 1. GENERAL COVERAGE This health insurance policy provides coverage for eligible medical expenses incurred during hospitalization, approved surgical procedures, emergency medical treatment, and specified day-care procedures. 2. HOSPITALIZATION COVERAGE Hospitalization expenses are covered when the insured person is admitted to a recognized hospital for medically necessary treatment. Covered expenses may include: - Hospital room charges - Nursing charges - Doctor consultation charges - Operation theatre charges - Medicines administered during hospitalization - Diagnostic tests related to the

treatment The minimum hospitalization period is 24 hours, except for approved day-care procedures. 3. SURGICAL PROCEDURES The following medically necessary surgical procedures are covered when approved under the policy: - Appendectomy - Hernia repair - Gallbladder surgery - Cataract surgery - Knee replacement - Emergency fracture surgery Surgical procedures must be medically necessary and supported by appropriate medical documentation. 4. COVERAGE LIMIT The maximum annual coverage limit under this sample policy is Rs. 5,00,000 per policy year. Claims exceeding the available coverage limit may be partially approved up to the remaining eligible amount or sent for manual review. 5. WAITING

PERIOD A general waiting period of 30 days applies from the beginning of the policy period for non-emergency illnesses. The waiting period does not apply to accidental emergency treatment, subject to policy conditions. 6. PRE-EXISTING DISEASES Pre-existing diseases are subject to a waiting period of 24 months. Treatment directly related to a pre-existing disease during the waiting period is not eligible for coverage unless specifically approved under the policy. 7. EXCLUSIONS The following expenses are generally excluded: - Cosmetic surgery without medical necessity - Treatment for non-medical purposes - Experimental treatments not approved under the policy - Expenses unrelated to

the diagnosed medical condition - Claims resulting from intentionally false information - Treatments specifically listed as exclusions in the policy 8. CLAIM DOCUMENTATION The following documents may be required: - Insurance policy details - Patient identification - Hospital bills - Medical reports - Doctor's prescription - Discharge summary - Diagnostic reports - Procedure details Incomplete documentation may result in manual review. 9. EMERGENCY TREATMENT Emergency hospitalization resulting from an accident or sudden life-threatening medical condition may be covered without the standard waiting period, subject to policy terms and available coverage. 10. MANUAL REVIEW A claim should be sent for manual

review when: - Required information is missing - Claim amount exceeds the normal coverage limit - Policy coverage is unclear - Conflicting medical information is present - Treatment may fall under an exclusion - Pre-existing condition is within the waiting period - Automated decision score is between 50 and 79 11. CLAIM DECISION GUIDELINES APPROVED: The claim satisfies the configured eligibility conditions. MANUAL REVIEW: The claim contains uncertainty, missing information, or requires human verification. REJECTED: The claim does not satisfy the configured policy conditions. 12. IMPORTANT NOTICE This document is a sample policy created for an academic software project. It
is not a real insurance contract and must not be used for actual insurance decisions.
